ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Deepcaller
ModMetaData.author: Nidelese
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Deepcaller psycaster path to Vanilla Psycasts Expanded.
Call writhing tentacles up from beneath the rimworld's crust to guard your home. Tentacles earn growth in battle and feed on the fallen, evolving from Sprout to Grasper to Crusher to Colossus with new attacks in each form. Raise an Idol of the Deep, feed its awakenings, and offer gold to cultivate your entire brood. Higher devotion discounts later purchases without a fixed discount ceiling.
An area-defense summoner path: control the ground, choose what gets close, and make them regret it.
